blocks.text:

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Parts i and ii are printed under a), but they are about the soda-water bottle and belong to c): c) i. Why must the bottle stay closed for this equilibrium? ii. Which way does the equilibrium shift when the cap is removed?

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The equation prints the hydrogencarbonate ion as HCO³⁻. The ion is HCO₃⁻ (three oxygen atoms, charge 1−), as the question itself writes it: CO₂(g) + H₂O(l) ⇌ HCO₃⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq).
